$comment: Owner gate 3. Draft allowlist for website memory facts and the anonymity check. Every stored string must equal an entry here after normalization (NFKC, lower case, whitespace collapsed to one space, trimmed, trailing . : … removed). Changing this file changes what can be stored: review it like a permission change. Version it with the contract.

site.language.values: lang: primaryLanguageTags; dir: ltr | rtl | null

ui.search.source: snapshot line '<role> "<name>"' with role in searchRoles and name in phrases.search

ui.login.values: path: page path if every segment is in pathSegments, else null

ui.control.source: snapshot line '<role> "<name>"' with role in controlRoles and name in any phrases group except search

primaryLanguageTags: Any ISO 639 primary subtag matching ^[a-z]{2,3}$; region, script and private-use subtags are dropped.

anonymityNames.$comment: Cookie and web-storage key NAMES that do not by themselves indicate a signed-in user (consent and first-party analytics). Exact names or a prefix ending in *. Any other name makes the page unverified (anonymous:false). Values are never read.
